move.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – full allocation for a firm two-year commitment
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we can accept your 54-day lead time, DAP, instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1).

On commitment, your letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We offer exactly that: a binding 23,400 pcs in each year over a 24-month term.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit. All other terms stay as in our enquiry: payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month commitment at 23,400 units per year and your acceptance of the 54-day lead time. In recognition of the extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Seal 24 mm – revised proposal with a three-year commitment
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming that you took our buyer estimate into account.

We would like to meet you with a further reciprocal step. We move from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.07/unit. We also add a third committed year: a binding 23,400 pcs in each year over 36 months. We continue to accept your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement.

This gives you a longer firm commitment than you asked for, together with our price movement and the longer delivery window. In return, we ask that the complete price recognises that commitment: full allocation of 23,400 pcs/year at EUR 31.07/unit.

All other terms remain as in our enquiry: payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Can you confirm this package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract term. In return for this extended commitment, we can offer a revised price of €31.50 per unit, with a Lieferzeit of 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

Please provide the underlying demand data to substantiate this three-year volume projection. Which volume can you commit to? 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Your quotation – requested volume information
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your question. The volume we can commit to is the already proposed 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each of the three contract years.

As planning data, our historical September 2026 forecast was 21,310 pcs for the next 12 months (fc:340010@2026-09). That forecast is separate from our proposed new binding requirement of 23,400 pcs/year.

This supplies the requested information and does not request any change to your quoted commercial terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
